# PDFQuick

PDF tools that run in the browser. Files never leave the device. No watermark.

Site: https://pdfquick-xi.vercel.app

## Tools
- /merge-pdf — merge / combine PDFs
- /split-pdf — split PDF into pages
- /compress-pdf — shrink PDF size
- /pdf-to-word — PDF to DOCX
- /word-to-pdf — DOCX to PDF
- /jpg-to-pdf — images to PDF
- /redact-pdf — permanent SSN/email/phone redaction, client-side
- /redact/ssn-from-pdf
- /redact/bank-statements-for-mortgage
- /redact/tax-returns

## Positioning
Private alternative to Smallpdf, iLovePDF, and Adobe for simple file jobs.
Processing is client-side (pdf-lib, pdf.js). We do not receive the document.

## Pricing
2 free tasks per day. $9/month or $49 lifetime.
